description: All reported values of one XBRL concept for one company (SEC companyconcept API), newest first, deduped by period. Use for any tag not in get_financials, e.g. us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense, us-gaap:LongTermDebt, dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding. framed_only=true keeps only SEC's one-fact-per-calendar-period values (cleanest time series).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

forms.description: Only facts from these forms, e.g. ['10-K']

tag.description: Concept name, case-sensitive, e.g. 'ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense'. 'us-gaap:Tag' form also accepted.

unit.description: e.g. USD, shares, USD/shares, pure. Default: USD if present else first unit

name: get_xbrl_concept
title: XBRL concept history
